findings.title: Flagged as malware by SafeDep (human verified)

aiReview.summary: This package contains only a trivial main.js that prints a message and no install scripts or network/exfiltration code; the SafeDep malware flag appears to be a false positive.
aiReview.reasoning: I inspected the package entry file (main.js) and package.json. main.js (lines 1–2) only logs "Test npm Package" and performs no I/O, network, or dynamic code evaluation. package.json declares no install-time scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) and no dependencies. The repository and CI files present in the package listing are not executed at install time. There is no code that collects secrets, spawns shells, downloads payloads, or sends data externally.

evidence.explanation: Single line that logs a test message: console.log("Test npm Package"). No other code present.
scripts only contains a test script; no preinstall/install/postinstall scripts.
version: "0.1.3" — metadata only; no dependencies or malicious fields.
